facebook.text:
Buying in Rawai, Phuket?

Rawai is at the southern end of Phuket, in Mueang Phuket district, between Nai Harn and Chalong. It has the widest mix in our catalogue: boutique and hotel-managed condominiums (Babylon Sky Garden and Babylon Sky Garden 2, The One Naiharn, The Title Adora and Cielo Rawai, Next Point), pool villas, and townhouses including Aileen Rawai Townhouses and Villa Sumalee.

We currently list 9 projects listed, advertised starting prices from THB 3,734,500.
Area guide with projects, nearby places and FAQs: https://estate.nightdestiny.com/locations/rawai/
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/66942654121

Prices and availability can change; check the project page or ask us for the current details. Images may be developer renders.
